name: windows-defender-realtime-on
title: Turn on Defender real-time protection
description: Turns Defender real-time protection on (Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $false) and reads the effective state back after 10 seconds. It refuses when Group Policy turns it off or another antivirus is in charge (Defender in passive mode).
measure: if (-not $s) { Add-ArhBlocker 'Microsoft Defender is not available on this computer'; Set-ArhPlan $false 'Nothing to do'; exit 0 }
if ($pol -and $pol.DisableRealtimeMonitoring -eq 1) { Add-ArhBlocker 'Group Policy turns real-time protection off' }
if ($mode -and $mode -ne 'Normal') { Add-ArhBlocker "Defender is in $mode: another antivirus is in charge" }
if ($s.RealTimeProtectionEnabled) { Set-ArhPlan $false 'Already on' } else { Set-ArhPlan $true 'Turn real-time protection on' }
